oral_examination.oral_examination: The lower front teeth are covered with a large amount of dental calculus, the gums have receded, and the oral hygiene is poor.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Full-mouth supragingival and subgingival scaling, root planing, irrigation, and iodine glycerin application.
